name: docusaurus-site
description: A new site's package.json, and the version pin every site reads. Each @docusaurus/* entry is one exact version, and shared:status holds a site to it. React and MUI stay ranges, read against each site's lock. To move the pin, change every @docusaurus/* entry here, then run shared:bump on each site. A new site also takes mermaid, the diagrams' package, on one exact version, 12.1.0, which shared:status does not hold the sites to: its katex range takes the site's KaTeX 0.16, while 12.2.0 and 12.3.0 want KaTeX 0.18 and nest a copy of their own, so maths inside a diagram would not match the 0.16 stylesheet the site serves. Before moving it, read the new version's range with npm view mermaid@<version> dependencies.katex. shared:new gives a new site its own name and description.

scripts.deploy: printf '%s\n' 'Nothing was deployed: this script only says how.' 'Deploy in two steps, with the netlify command on your PATH:' '  nvm use && netlify build && netlify deploy --prod --no-build' && exit 1
scripts.shared:verify: npm run test:site && npm run test:shared
